novelty.basis: Provides the first all-k analytic proof of 3k-1 three-setting steering saturation, introduces an equatorial-plus-Z witness beating the regular tetrahedron at eta_eq(4) = 4/13, discovers a 16x CHSH gain via bucket-detector role swapping, and proves cyclotomic Galois rationality of harmonic frame permanents.

reproducibility.basis: Ships self-contained Lean 4.35.0 proofs, an AST-audited zero-float exact rational/Q(sqrt(5)) verifier producing 16 SHA-256 certificates in MANIFEST.json, and 56 adversarial pytest checks, all independently executed and matching the compiled PDF SHA-256.

rigor.basis: Strictly enforces physical squeezing 0 < lambda < 1 across all branches, explicitly lifts filtered two-qubit witnesses to the unfiltered Fock space, and eliminates solver precision artifacts via constructive Lean 4 and exact rational certificates.

summary: This paper resolves three open analytical problems from Chakrabarty (arXiv:2611.34874v1) for k-mode Gaussian networks. First, a 2n-matrix equatorial-plus-Z dual steering witness on the one-photon-filtered TMSV subspace gives critical transmission eta_eq(n) = [1 + (n-1)^2 sin^2(pi/(2n-2))]^-1, proving SR_3^filt(eta) >= (3/80)(3*eta-1)^2 with physical squeezing lambda in (0,1) and lifting to full Fock space to certify 3k-1 three-setting steering saturation for all k >= 1, while achieving eta_eq(4) = 4/13 (certifying ceil(13k/4)-1 > 3k-1 neighbors). Second, assigning the bucket detector O_pi = I - 2|0><0| and O_{pi/2} to the neighbor aligns multiphoton noise constructively, giving B_j >= 2 + 1/((2k-1)(k+1)) (4x to 16x sharpening over Theorem 7). Third, exact Fock-Bargmann permanent identities, cyclotomic Galois rationality (exact k=3 values), parity-split Wigner bounds, and the (3/2)(4/27)^k heralding asymptote are proved and backed by 20 constructive Lean 4.35.0 theorems and 56 passing tests.
strengths: Replaces Chakrabarty's k <= 50 numerical SDP certificates with an explicit closed-form 2n-matrix dual steering witness and non-asymptotic quadratic robustness lower bound valid for all k >= 1 with strictly physical squeezing lambda in (0,1) and full-Fock-space lifting.

Exploits the Z-biased photon-loss noise asymmetry of the lossy TMSV to achieve eta_eq(4) = 4/13 < 0.3077, beating the regular tetrahedron threshold and strictly surpassing 3k-1 steering neighbors for every k >= 1.

Identifies that swapping the on/off bucket detector O_pi = I - 2|0><0| onto the lossy neighbor mode turns multiphoton noise p_21 - p_20 > 0 constructive, proving a 4x (k=1) to 16x (asymptotic) CHSH margin improvement without calculus.

Establishes exact Fock-Bargmann permanent formulas N_k = perm(G_k) and p_1 = perm(G_k/G_00)/perm(G_k), proves their general-k rationality via cyclotomic Galois invariance, computes exact k=3 rational values, sharpens general-k Wigner negativity, and derives the (3/2)(4/27)^k(1 + 1/(12k) + O(k^-2)) heralding law.
Backed by independent machine verification: 20 constructive Lean 4.35.0 theorems (0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice), 16 SHA-256 zero-float certificates, and 56 passing adversarial tests.
weaknesses: Minor LaTeX theorem-numbering discrepancy in the compiled PDF: lemma and remark share the theorem counter in main.tex, so Theorems 1, 2, and 3 in the abstract and section titles render as Theorems 2, 4, and 5 in the body and figure captions.

Formal Lean 4.35.0 coverage certifies the cleared-denominator polynomial/rational inequalities and exact k=2,3 Z[sqrt(5)] permanents, while infinite-dimensional Fock-space lifting, trigonometric Lemma 1, general-k Galois invariance, and log-asymptotic expansions are proved analytically in prose.

Within the qubit-block observable class, equatorial-plus-Z thresholds converge to (1 + pi^2/4)^-1 ~ 0.2884 rather than closing the gap to the 1/n monogamy floor for n >= 4, and Bell nonlocality beyond CHSH (such as I_3322) remains open.
strong_novelty_candidates: Analytic all-k 3k-1 three-setting steering saturation via an explicit rank-1 equatorial-plus-Z dual witness with physical squeezing lambda in (0,1) and full-Fock-space robustness lifting.
Equatorial n-setting threshold formula eta_eq(n) yielding the exact rational n=4 threshold 4/13, certifying ceil(13k/4)-1 > 3k-1 four-setting steering neighbors for all k >= 1.
Bucket-detector CHSH role-swapping (16x asymptotic improvement) and cyclotomic Galois invariance proving exact rationality of harmonic tight-frame permanents N_k and p_1(|Phi_k>) for all k >= 1.
